title: The nature of sub-millimetre galaxies II: an ALMA comparison of SMG dust heating mechanisms
question: Compare the contribution of Active Galactic Nuclei (AGN) and star-formation towards dust heating in sub-millimetre galaxies (SMGs) by comparing their sub-mm sizes, extents relative to host galaxies, FIR luminosities, and SFR surface densities to known quasars.

recipe.goal: Calibrate and image ALMA continuum data and check flux recovery
recipe.method: Run standard ALMA data reduction and calibration scripts in CASA v4.7.2 without additional tapering or cleaning, and compare integrated ALMA fluxes with APEX LABOCA flux densities.

recipe.goal: Measure sub-mm continuum sizes and flux densities
recipe.method: Fit 2D Gaussians to the ALMA continuum maps using the CASA imfit routine to measure apparent and beam-deconvolved major and minor axis FWHMs, integrated flux densities, and peak flux densities.
assumptions: H0 = 70 km s^-1 Mpc^-1, Omega_m = 0.3, Omega_Lambda = 0.7

recipe.goal: Measure optical/NIR host galaxy profiles and compare extents to ALMA
recipe.method: Extract radial profiles from ALMA, HST ACS i-band, and Calar Alto H-band images using IRAF imexamine, fit 1D Gaussian functions using scipy.optimize.curve_fit, deconvolve PSF/beam, and compute optical/NIR to FIR size ratios.
key_parameters: HST ACS i-band resolution 0.1"; Calar Alto H-band seeing 0.9"

recipe.goal: Derive dust masses, FIR luminosities, SFRs, and SFR surface densities
recipe.method: Model dust continuum emission as a modified blackbody to compute M_dust and L_FIR/L_IR from observed S_870 or S_1200, convert L_IR to SFR_IR, and divide by effective area or beam area to obtain galaxy-averaged and peak SFR surface densities (including recalculating ALESS SMG values for consistency).
key_parameters: R_e = mean of deconvolved major and minor axes FWHM / 2; galaxy-averaged Sigma_SFR = (0.5 * SFR_IR) / (pi * R_e^2); peak Sigma_SFR = SFR_IR(peak) / (pi * a * b / (4 ln 2))
assumptions: Opacity law kappa(nu) = 0.077 * (nu / 352 GHz)^beta m^2 kg^-2 with dust emissivity index beta = 1.6
T_dust = AGN dust temperature from Shanks et al. (2021) when available, otherwise 35 K for WHDF sources, and 47 K for z>6 quasars
Chabrier IMF and SFR_IR / (M_sun yr^-1) = 1.49e-10 * (L_IR / L_sun)
Eddington limit lower bound Sigma_SFR ~ 650 M_sun yr^-1 kpc^-2 assuming gas fraction f_gas = 1 and dust-to-gas ratio f_dg = 1/90

recipe.goal: Test correlation between MIR luminosity and MIR/FIR flux ratios in AS2UDS
recipe.method: Plot S_100um/S_24um and S_24um/S_8um flux ratios against absolute 4.5 um magnitude M_4.5 for AS2UDS SMGs and X-ray/K-excess QSOs, and perform a maximum likelihood linear fit on a redshift-restricted (1 < z < 1.7) subsample.
key_parameters: Redshift cut 1 < z < 1.7 for completeness test (68 SMGs, 43 with 24 um detections, 15 with 100 um detections)
assumptions: Zero K-correction for the [4.5] um band assuming spectral slope f_lambda proportional to lambda^-1 for lambda < 4.5 um

missing_for_reproduction: Resolution of the integration-limit discrepancy between Eq. 3 (3-1100 um) and Table 6 footnote (42.5-122.5 um) and the exact conversion factor used to produce the SFR_IR column in Table 6.

score_reason: The ALMA project codes are explicitly stated, the data reduction uses the standard ALMA pipeline in CASA v4.7.2 without custom cleaning or tapering, and the core measurements use standard CASA imfit and analytic modified blackbody equations. Minor deductions are due to the ambiguity in the exact FIR integration limits/conversion factor in Table 6 and reliance on non-ALMA WHDF optical/NIR images for Table 3.
rediscovery_reason: Both ALMA project codes (2016.1.01523.S and 2016.1.01510.S) are public, the authors used the standard archive pipeline scripts as-is in CASA, and the main ALMA deliverables (2D Gaussian sizes and flux densities in Tables 2 and 5 via CASA imfit, plus derived dust masses and luminosities in Table 6) are concrete numeric tables ideal for automated reproduction.
